name: Sanne van Dijk
title: Junior Site Reliability Engineer
summary: Junior Site Reliability Engineer with hands-on experience supporting cloud-native platforms, improving monitoring coverage, and automating repetitive operational tasks. Comfortable working with Kubernetes, Linux, CI/CD pipelines, and incident response in fast-paced environments, with a strong focus on reliability, observability, and collaboration.

bullets: Supported a 24/7 Kubernetes platform serving 40+ internal applications, helping maintain 99.93% monthly availability.
Created Grafana dashboards and Prometheus alerts that reduced mean time to detect incidents by 28%.
Automated routine cluster maintenance tasks with Bash and GitLab CI, saving roughly 6 hours per week for the operations team.
Assisted with CI/CD pipeline improvements for 12 application teams, reducing average deployment time by 35%.
Helped standardize logging and alerting patterns across services, improving incident triage consistency.
Documented runbooks and operational checklists that shortened onboarding time for new team members by 2 weeks.
Monitored server and application health across Linux-based environments, resolving 200+ service tickets with an average 95% SLA compliance.
Supported patching and access management workflows for approximately 150 endpoints and service accounts.
Participated in weekly incident reviews and contributed actionable follow-up tasks that lowered repeat incidents by 18%.
Assisted in maintaining internal lab systems and virtual machines used by research teams across 3 departments.
Performed basic troubleshooting for network, storage, and authentication issues, closing 60+ requests during the traineeship.
Helped improve asset documentation accuracy by updating configuration records for over 120 systems.
